key.name: target-monitor
key.description: The connector name of the monitor (for example DP-2) that gets the top panel while the primary monitor shows a fullscreen window. Empty: the first monitor that is not in fullscreen. When the chosen monitor is not connected or is in fullscreen itself, the first free one is used.

key.name: move-hot-corners
key.description: Move the hot corner of the primary monitor along with the top panel.

key.name: move-notifications
key.description: Show notification banners on the monitor that has the top panel.
